desc: Prove that processing values from \(N\) down to \(1\) yields an optimal sorting sequence, including why no alternative crossing order has lower cost.
Derive and verify the current rank of each value after larger values are fixed.
Design Fenwick tree operations to maintain active positions and compute current ranks.
Implement the arithmetic-series cost using Python integers.
Produce and sample-test the complete stdin/stdout Python solution with \(O(N\log N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory.
